title: Amiodarone Against ICD Therapy in Chagas Cardiomyopathy for Primary Prevention of Death
brief_summary: The primary objective is to compare the efficacy of the treatment using implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) implantation to that of the treatment using amiodarone in the primary prevention of all-cause mortality in high-risk patients with Chagas cardiomyopathy and non-sustained ventricular tachycardia (NSVT).
condition: At Least 10 Points in Rassi Risk Score for Death
